string.name: desc
string.value:
Double-click to open the #cColoring Prism# window.
#cItems# dyes whatever you drag onto the slot, any equip or a Cash effect item. The two badges under the preview choose whether you are dyeing the item itself or the effects it plays, and each keeps its own color. #cSkills# dyes a skill you drag in from your Skill window. #cHair#, #cEyes# and #cSkin# dye your own look, and need nothing dragged in.
Drag the #cHue, Chroma and Value# sliders until it looks the way you want, then press OK. One prism is used per dye, and the color is kept until you dye it again.
Zero all three sliders before OK to put that color back to its original shade.
